2. 吃掉一份食物 [eat] {action=eat amount=1} 前提:food >= 1、hunger < 80

4. 去仓库核实存粮 [move] {action=move purpose=verify-stock to=warehouse} 前提:alive
5. 前往仓库 [move] {action=move purpose=travel to=warehouse} 前提:alive
6. 前往workshop [move] {action=move purpose=task-place to=workshop} 前提:alive
7. 为御寒准备炉火 [refuel] {action=refuel amount=2 taskId=task-1 taskType=PREPARE_WARMTH} 前提:firewood >= 1
